statement: The synthetic C5 evdev fixture is generated from pinned hid-wiimote key maps, node names and input_set_abs_params calls, with numeric codes resolved from the same kernel input-event-codes header. It preserves separate base/accel/IR/Nunchuk/Classic/MotionPlus nodes and consumer fuzz/flat values. It is not a recorded device or proof of actual binding.
